institution.description: Name of the organization that collected the data.

sector.description: The sector of the organization that collected the data. If you are submitting for an IOOS Regional Association (RA), select 'ioos_ra'

enum.title: Funder
enum.description:
Party providing monetary support for the resource.
 - ***AOOS***
 - ***USGS***

enum.title: Custodian
enum.description:
Party that accepts accountability and responsibility for the data, and ensures appropriate care and maintenance of the resource.
 - ***JOA Surveys** (the organization that is servicing the station)*

enum.title: Community Point of Contact
enum.description:
Name of community contact, if applicable. This information is **not reported to ERDDAP**. It is only recorded for RA project tracking purposes.
 - ***Person ABC** (the POC who is aware of the station or provides access to the site)*

enum.title: Data Publisher
enum.description:
Party who published the resource.
 - ***JOA Surveys** (The organization that shares the data via API or other access point)*

enum.title: Data Processor
enum.description:
Party that has processed the data in a manner such that the resource has been modified.
 - ***Tetra Tech***

enum.title: Distributor
enum.description:
Party who distributes the resource. Example, Hohonu, Divirod, etc. These distributors provide a packaged instrument, not a single sensor.
 - ***Hohonu***

platform_name.title: Station Name
platform_name.description: The station name should be descriptive of its location. The station name should be the same on all records (metadata form, field data sheet, etc).

horizontal-datum.title: Horizontal reference system
horizontal-datum.description: Horizontal datum for the lat/lon (eg: NAD83) / projection

wmo_platform_code.title: NWS Location Identifier
wmo_platform_code.description: NOAA requirement for NWS use. It may be requested via local WFOs, or the IOOS program office can facilitate a mass request directly with NWS.

additional-information.title: Additional information
additional-information.description: Provide any additional information for the station such as power source (AC, solar, etc) or other site specifics that may be relevant

total-water-level-error-cm.title: Total Water level Error (cm):
total-water-level-error-cm.description: For reference, see [Estimating Total Vertical Uncertainty Of Short Term And Partner Water Level Observations April 2025 from NOAA/CO-OPS](https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&source=web&rct=j&opi=89978449&url=https://repository.library.noaa.gov/view/noaa/70293/noaa_70293_DS1.pdf&ved=2ahUKEwiByKSvtPOVAxUxADQIHRA3MJEQFnoECBUQAQ&usg=AOvVaw2t1WoQiXWD9_MPhwa2s9mk)

computation-tool.title: Tidal datum computation method
computation-tool.description: The [NOAA CO-OPS Tidal Datum Calculator](https://access.co-ops.nos.noaa.gov/datumcalc/) includes links to resources, including a [user guide](https://access.co-ops.nos.noaa.gov/datumcalc/docs/UserGuide.pdf).

computation-period.title: Computation period
computation-period.description: Period of data that was used to compute the datums. If VDatum was used, leave this field blank.

datum-type.title: Datum Type:
datum-type.description: Standard NTDE Datum Type: Identifies the National Tidal Datum Epoch (NTDE) used to compute the reported tidal datums. The NTDE is NOAA's official 19-year period for calculating standard tidal datums (e.g., MHHW, MHW, MSL, MLW, MLLW), ensuring consistency among stations and over time.  Modified Procedure refers to the method used to compute tidal datums when a station does not have a full 19-year record spanning the National Tidal Datum Epoch (NTDE).

station-datum.title: Station Datum Reference Point and Description
station-datum.description: Text description of how station datum is defined. Include bench mark stampings or other specific information to record the establishment.

navd88-m.title: NAVD88 (m):
navd88-m.description: Offset between station datum and NAVD88

nad83-m.title: Ellipsoidal Height (NAD83) (m):
nad83-m.description: Offset between station datum and NAD83

mhhw-m.title: Mean Higher High Water (MHHW) (m):
mhhw-m.description: Offset between station datum and mean higher high water (MHHW) in meters.

mhw-m.title: Mean High Water (MHW) (m):
mhw-m.description: Offset between station datum and mean high water (MHW) in meters.

mlw-m.title: Mean Low Water (MLW) (m):
mlw-m.description: Offset between station datum and mean low water (MLW) in meters.

mllw-m.title: Mean Lower Low Water (MLLW) (m):
mllw-m.description: Offset between station datum and mean lower low water (MLLW) in meters.

dtl-m.title: Diurnal Tide Level (DTL) (m):
dtl-m.description: The arithmetic mean of mean higher high water and mean lower low water.

mtl-m.title: Mean Tide Level (MTL) (m):
mtl-m.description: The arithmetic mean of mean high water and mean low water.

msl-m.title: Mean Sea Level (MSL) (m):
msl-m.description: The arithmetic mean of hourly heights observed over the National Tidal Datum Epoch. Shorter series are specified in the name; e.g. monthly mean sea level and yearly mean sea level.

gt-m.title: Great Diurnal Range (GT) (m)
gt-m.description: The difference in height between mean higher high water and mean lower low water.

mn-m.title: Mean Range of Tide (MN) (m):
mn-m.description: The difference in height between mean high water and mean low water.

dhq-m.title: Mean Diurnal High Water Inequality (DHQ) (m):
dhq-m.description: One-half the average difference between the two high waters of each tidal day observed over the National Tidal Datum Epoch. It is obtained by subtracting the mean of all the high waters from the mean of the higher high waters.

dlq-m.title: Mean Diurnal High Water Inequality (DLQ) (m):
dlq-m.description: One-half the average difference between the two low waters of each tidal day observed over the National Tidal Datum Epoch. It is obtained by subtracting the mean of the lower low waters from the mean of all the low waters.

hwi-hr.title: High Water Interval (HWI) (hr):
hwi-hr.description: The average interval (in hours) between the moon's transit over the Greenwich meridian and the following high water at a location.

lwi-hr.title: Low Water Interval (LWI) (hr):
lwi-hr.description: The average interval (in hours) between the moon's transit over the Greenwich meridian and the following low water at a location.

additional-colocation-information[].title: Additional information
additional-colocation-information[].description: Add link to colocated dataset (ERDDAP link, portal link, if available)

benchmarks-photo.title: Photo of bench mark(s)
benchmarks-photo.description: Suggested 4 minimum photos include: Bench mark face clearly showing stamping, setting (generally taken from chest height) and 2 directional photos. Ideally, provide photos of all 4 directions to help find the mark on future visits and/or to help validate suitability for things such as GPS/GNSS (things that could obstruct a signal: tree, fence, building, etc)

underwater-components.title: Water level sensor
underwater-components.description: Photos of the water level sensor. Suggestion to take a close up of the sensor and related equipment, data logger, etc.

vicinity.title: Vicinity
vicinity.description: Additional photos of the area surrounding the water level sensor

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.description: NOAA specific req for NWS ingestion. specify uncertainty and limitations of use

dissemination-flag.title: Dissemination flag
dissemination-flag.description: NOAA specific req for NWS ingestion

shef-element-code.title: SHEF physical element code
shef-element-code.description: For tidal stations, the SHEF physical element must be "HC" (which NWPS parses as MHHW), while riverine or inundation stations must use "HG" (parsed as stage height)

api-external-identifier.title: External identifier if needed when accessing API

api-documentation.title: Link to API documentation or source page

api-access.title: Link or contact information for how to gain API access

instrument.title: Instrument Technology
instrument.description: Instrument is the large physical instrument that may house individual or smaller components, aka sensors.

instrument_variable:make_model.title: Instrument make/model
instrument_variable:make_model.description: The make and model of the instrument.

sensor-serial-number.title: Serial number of instrument or component
sensor-serial-number.description: The serial number of the instrument. If you have multiple sensors within an instrument, add each sensor serial number.

difference-since-last-survey.title: If so, what is the difference?

sensor-offset.title: Sensor Vertical Offset from Survey Reference Point (m, + is above STND, - is below STND)
sensor-offset.description: Physical offset between sensor zero and a survey reference point (offset calibration). This should be a numerical entry, measured in meters. (+) values are above station datum, (-) values are below station datum

sensor-survey-reference-point.title: Sensor survey reference point
sensor-survey-reference-point.description: Text description of the location on the sensor that was surveyed to measure the elevation of the sensor

sensor-elevation-on-station-datum.title: Sensor Zero Elevation Relative to Station Datum (m)
sensor-elevation-on-station-datum.description: Distance from station datum (STND) to sensor zero, or the point at which the instrument measures

sensor-elevation-survey-date.title: Sensor Elevation Survey Date (if different from install date)
sensor-elevation-survey-date.description: Date when sensor elevations were surveyed. If the sensor was previously installed but the elevation changed (i.e., sensor was moved), this date is critical.

sensor-elevation-ortho.title: Sensor Zero Elevation Relative to Orthometric Datum (m, + is above STND, - is below STND)
sensor-elevation-ortho.description: Measured elevation in meters of sensor zero relative to a specified orthometric datum

sensor-elevation-ellipsoidal.title: Sensor Zero Elevation Relative to Ellipsoidal Reference (m, + is above STND, - is below STND)
sensor-elevation-ellipsoidal.description: Measured elevation in meters of sensor zero relative to a specified ellipsoidal reference

sensor-elevation-ellipsoidal-refsys.title: Reference system used for ellipsoidal elevation

sensor-elevation-dynamic.title: Sensor Zero Elevation Relative to Dynamic Reference (m, + is above STND, - is below STND)
sensor-elevation-dynamic.description: Measured elevation in meters of sensor zero relative to a specified dynamic reference

sensor-elevation-dynamic-refsys.title: Reference system used for dynamic elevation

marker-ngs-pid.title: Bench mark NGS PID
enum: Not available - this opens up the VM# field

marker-co-ops-vm.title: Bench mark CO-OPS VM#
marker-co-ops-vm.description: A NOAA CO-OPS Vertical Mark Number (VM #) is a unique numeric identifier assigned to a specific tidal or water level bench mark in the Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services database

measurement-by-at-most-recent-survey.title: Surveyed by
measurement-by-at-most-recent-survey.description: Name of organization responsible for survey

bench-mark-descriptions.title: Bench mark description
bench-mark-descriptions.description: [For guidance on how best to describe a bench mark, utilize the NGS documentation](https://geodesy.noaa.gov/surveys/mark-recovery/mark-descriptions-help.shtml#notes)

elevation.title: Bench mark height on Station Datum (STND) (m)
